name: Power (v3, Velum)
author: henri
description: The battery in the menu bar on Velum: "84 %" + the drawn battery; a click grows the right island into the battery menu, the same pages as the Control Center's Battery (henri.control-center-v3 PowerService/PowerPages): overview, charge limit, history from 15 min to 7 days, power profiles, fans, power flow, charge mode and USB

barWidget.description: Battery glyph; opens the Control Center's battery menu in the right island

schema.label: Show battery percentage in the bar
